meta.about: Machine-readable exam patterns that drive the Mock Test mode on /ssc-je. The CI agent ExamPatterns (scripts/site-agent.js) re-checks news/official signals every run and may update entries here ONLY with a source link and sanity-checked numbers; the quiz page reads this file at load, so a pattern change reaches mocks on the next deploy without any page edit. agentMockPapers writes fresh pattern-matched questions to data/mock-fresh.json. Baseline numbers below are the published paper structures; 'min' on each mock is the technical share of the real paper duration.

patterns.name: SSC JE Paper 1 — Technical (Part A)
patterns.desc: the 100-question Part A share of the real 200-question paper (GA + Reasoning sections join when their pools are wired)
patterns.source: SSC JE Paper-I (CBT): 200 Q / 200 marks / 2 hours, negative marking 0.25; Part A = 100 technical questions

patterns.name: RRB JE CBT-2 — Technical Abilities
patterns.desc: the 100-question Technical Abilities share of the real 150-question CBT-2
patterns.source: RRB JE CBT-2: 150 Q / 120 min, negative marking 1/3; Technical Abilities = 100 questions

patterns.name: Quick Mock
patterns.desc: short timed paper for daily practice
